# Invitation Draft: Independent Release Authority

**Recipient:** [Nominate only after written authority verification]

Subject: PARMAR independent Release Authority review request

Please review the complete Gate 1-7 evidence chain and exact deployment scope.
Confirm GitHub ruleset/Environment evidence, atomic-fence NO-GO, production
OIDC disablement and approved PO-13 Option A; no subscription or entitlement change.

Required authority: organization release/change-control authority independent
of implementation and specialist authorship.

Artifacts: `.github/approval/review-packages/release-authority.md`,
`.github/approval/GITHUB-GOVERNANCE-ACTIVATION-PACKAGE.md` and the exact
worktree SHA-256 values under `roles.Release Authority` in
`.github/approval/specialist-handoff-artifacts.json`. These are candidate
digests only; verify and rebind them to the exact reviewed commit before
submitting an approval record.

Return `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `NEEDS_CHANGES` only for the exact release
scope and commit. No blanket future approval.
